svg.title: Two tones in, two spikes out
svg.desc: Top: 20 milliseconds of a signal that is the sum of a 500 hertz sine of amplitude 1 and a 1500 hertz sine of amplitude 0.5. Bottom: its spectrum, which is zero everywhere except for a spike of height 1 at 500 hertz and one of height 0.5 at 1500 hertz.
svg.text: Two tones in, two spikes out
THE SIGNAL: 20 MS OF 500 HZ + 1500 HZ
